paragraphs.source_en: CEO of Herman Miller, argues that’s the best way to treat everyone: “The best people working for organizations are like volunteers. Since they could probably ﬁnd good jobs in any number of groups, they choose to work somewhere for reasons less tangible than salary or position. Volunteers do not need contracts, they need covenants.... Covenantal relationships induce freedom, not paralysis. A covenantal relationship rests on shared commitment to ideas, to issues, to values, to goals, and to management process. Words such as love, warmth, personal chemistry, are certainly pertinent.
